knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic supply-chain snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled routes, disruption events, risk scores, mitigation playbooks, and supplier candidates provide deterministic review evidence.

knowledge.name: Disruption rules and operational controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define risk bands, impact calculations, scenario logic, evidence anchors, approval gates, and prohibited actions.

knowledge.name: Locked persona and operation cases
knowledge.detail: Four cases preserve exact disruption, route, mitigation, and supplier evidence for repeatable Brainstem and Copilot Studio validation.

intelligence_processing.name: Active disruption impact review
intelligence_processing.detail: Aggregates active events, affected routes and SKUs, modeled delays, resolution dates, and synthetic revenue exposure for review.

intelligence_processing.name: Route risk-factor assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Classifies route scores by fixed thresholds and explains weather, labor, infrastructure, regulatory, financial, and geopolitical factors.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft mitigation scenario preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps a disruption type to immediate, short-term, and long-term playbook options with modeled cost and risk reduction.

intelligence_processing.name: Alternative-supplier due-diligence comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic lead time, quality, capacity, premium, minimum quantity, and certifications without substituting a supplier.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed evidence filtering
intelligence_processing.detail: Filters only exact route, disruption, or category identifiers and returns no invented or substituted record when evidence is absent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file agent through local chat and streaming endpoints with four independently routable, read-only operations.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts four behaviors and two synthetic knowledge files with integrated authentication, no web search, and no published agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Operations review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives planners, operations leaders, procurement managers, and fulfillment leads evidence-first results for human review.

management_reporting.name: Supply Chain Disruption Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports active events, affected routes and SKUs, delays, severity, resolution estimates, and modeled revenue at risk.

management_reporting.name: Supply Chain Risk Assessment
management_reporting.detail: Reports route-level overall risk, fixed risk labels, factor scores, distribution, and highest contributing factors.

management_reporting.name: Draft Disruption Mitigation Scenario
management_reporting.detail: Reports proposed playbook options, time horizons, modeled investment, and expected risk reduction for authorized review.

management_reporting.name: Alternative Supplier Directory
management_reporting.detail: Reports due-diligence candidates and comparison attributes while making no supplier qualification, substitution, award, or activation.

tools.name: SupplyChainDisruptionAlertAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable single-file Python BasicAgent implements four deterministic operations over bundled synthetic supply-chain records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four behaviors and two knowledge files; publication requires separate confirmation.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: Routes natural-language requests to one operation and composes responses from deterministic evidence and package instructions.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
tools.detail: Approved future seam for governed operational data; the packaged pilot has no live connection and performs no system write.

tools.name: Approved supplier-risk feed
tools.detail: Future least-privilege input for risk evidence; this agent reviews disruption continuity rather than monitoring supplier health.

tools.name: Transportation management system
tools.detail: Future approved source for route and shipment state; the current package cannot reroute, dispatch, or modify a shipment.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams authorized collaboration
tools.detail: Future review seam for authorized collaboration; the current package sends no alert, message, approval, or notification.

supporting_features.name: Four preserved review operations
supporting_features.detail: Keeps disruption_dashboard, risk_assessment, mitigation_plan, and supplier_alternatives independently routable and read-only.

supporting_features.name: Disruption-continuity scope
supporting_features.detail: Focuses on events, routes, impacts, mitigation scenarios, and candidate review, distinct from supplier-risk monitoring.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses bundled fictional records only and forbids browsing, enrichment, replacement facts, or invention of missing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Human operations and procurement gates
supporting_features.detail: Operations and procurement owners retain every decision; future writes require authorization, confirmation, and audit logging.

supporting_features.name: No supplier substitution or order action
supporting_features.detail: Prevents supplier qualification, selection, substitution, contracting, activation, purchase-order changes, and inventory movement.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous routing or alert sending
supporting_features.detail: Prevents shipment rerouting, dispatch, customer contact, counterparty outreach, alert delivery, messages, and notifications.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and Draft control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed deterministic and Copilot Studio previews while validated builds remained Draft and unpublished.
